messages:
Mia Chen: hitting a crash in hf-to-redwood converter on a new LlamaX bring-up, looks safetensors-related and weird when auth token rotates
Mia Chen: reproduce: `python -m hf_to_redwood.convert --repo zzz/llamax-sft --revision main --out /tmp/conv`
Mia Chen: error snippet:
```
safetensors.exceptions.SafetensorsException: mmap failed: unexpected EOF while reading shard-00001-of-00004.safetensors
during mmapping /tmp/conv/weights/shard-00001-of-00004.safetensors
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "convert.py", line 234, in load_shard
    mmap = np.memmap(path, mode='r')
ValueError: mmap length mismatch
```
Jonah Park: are we using mmap for downloaded shards? mmap on partial/truncated files will explode like that
Sophia Rivera: looks like `snapshot_download` was used and it can create the target file before the full stream completes if a 403/interrupt happens -> leaves truncated file, then later mmap fails
Mia Chen: I also saw a 403 in the logs right before the mmap error — hub token rotated during large batch downloads :facepalm:
Jonah Park: quick mitigation: never mmap unless the file size & sha256 from the safetensors index match; otherwise stream to tempfile and os.replace
Mia Chen: reproduction steps I used:
1) export HF_TOKEN=old_token
2) start convert with `--parallel 4`
3) rotate token (simulate 403)
4) converter reports shard written but truncated, later mmap crashes
Sophia Rivera: concrete patch idea:
```
# download shard safely
tmp = Path(dst) / (shard_name + ".part")
stream_download(url, tmp)
verify_sha256(tmp, expected)
os.replace(tmp, Path(dst) / shard_name)
# only mmap after verify
```
Jonah Park: also add retries on 403 with short backoff and re-auth attempt; and ensure snapshot_download is called with `revision=` pinned when available (we saw `main` fallback causing mismatches)
Mia Chen: interesting: converter was supposed to pin revision hash for each artifact but the codepath for multipart safetensors skipped the pin check — that'll make rollbacks impossible if index+shards mismatch
hf-convert-bot: CI job queued: test/safetensors-downloads on branch safetensors-tempfile-fix (runs 12m)
Sophia Rivera: can someone add a small integration test that simulates mid-download 403 and asserts we never leave a final file with size != expected?
Mia Chen: I'll add the test and open the PR with tempfile+atomic rename + pinned revision guard. Keeping mmap as opt-in after verification for local dirs only.
Jonah Park: lgtm, thanks. once PR lands run it against zzz/llamax and the internal benchmark suite (latency/accuracy) to rule out subtle corruption
Mia Chen: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
